resumeMeta.name: Prem Kumar
resumeMeta.title: Senior Associate | Frontend & Power Platform Specialist

home.name: Prem Kumar
home.summary: Senior Associate with 4.5+ years of experience driving high-impact frontend and Power Platform solutions for enterprise customers.

paragraphs: Frontend & Power Platform Specialist with 4.5+ years of expertise delivering scalable enterprise solutions using Angular, React, Power Pages, Power Apps, and Dataverse.
Proven skills in reusable component architecture, UI performance optimization, automation-driven business workflows, and clean maintainable code.
Experienced in building production-ready applications with strong user experience, accessibility, responsive design, and cross-team collaboration.

experiences.role: Senior Associate — Power Platform Solution Architect
bullets: Collaborated with clients to gather business requirements and architect end-to-end enterprise solutions using Microsoft Power Platform.
Developed scalable Power Pages, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Copilot Studio solutions for business-critical workflows.
Built secure, customized Power Pages portals with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Liquid, and advanced Dataverse integrations.
Designed automation workflows, data models, security roles, and integrations to deliver scalable digital operations.
Delivered AI-powered copilots using Copilot Studio and Dataverse to enhance business processes and decision support.
Led solution delivery, mentored junior developers, and coordinated cross-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.

experiences.role: Technology Analyst — Frontend & Power Platform Developer
bullets: Developed scalable, responsive frontend applications using Angular, React, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and Tailwind CSS for enterprise platforms.
Designed and maintained a shared UI component library to ensure design consistency, modular architecture, and faster delivery.
Implemented interactive amCharts dashboards and visualizations to make complex data intuitive for business users.
Resolved UI and integration issues to improve performance, stability, and user experience across applications.
Maintained clean code, documentation, and release-ready patterns to support onboarding and collaborative delivery.
Applied advanced Angular concepts including RxJS, Observables, interceptors, dependency injection, and modular design patterns.
Developed and enhanced frontend interfaces for enterprise applications supporting Intel engineering workflows.
Built and maintained Angular-based UI components with a strong focus on performance, responsiveness, and maintainability.
Designed and delivered interactive, data-driven dashboards using amCharts to make technical metrics actionable.
Created reusable and modular UI components to improve consistency and reduce development effort.
Collaborated with client stakeholders and backend teams for requirements gathering and seamless integration.

enterpriseProjects.title: Meridian – Web Conferencing Platform
enterpriseProjects.description: Developed features including real-time chat, Q&A modules, and configurable charts for virtual meetings and webinars.

enterpriseProjects.title: ENOWA Request Tracking Application
enterpriseProjects.description: Designed and developed a centralized request tracking application using Microsoft Power Platform to manage energy-related and operational requests. Enabled users to create, assign, track, and monitor requests through structured workflows and automated notifications. Improved process transparency and turnaround time using Power Automate workflows and Dataverse models.

enterpriseProjects.title: Community Sites – Music & Scuba Clubs
enterpriseProjects.description: Delivered polished, responsive interfaces with strong emphasis on usability, accessibility, and visual consistency for community engagement platforms.

enterpriseProjects.title: Angular Design System / Seed Kit
enterpriseProjects.description: Part of the core UI engineering team developing an Angular Seed Kit / Design System for a large-scale UK healthcare program. Built Storybook-driven reusable components including typography systems, color tokens, spacing, buttons, and atomic UI elements.

enterpriseProjects.title: Client Quality Indicator Dashboard
enterpriseProjects.description: Developed a dashboard-driven application to monitor and visualize product quality metrics for Intel engineering teams. Improved data analysis efficiency through clear visual representations and well-structured Angular components.

enterpriseProjects.title: IP Comparison Tool
enterpriseProjects.description: Built UI features to compare power output and performance metrics across different platforms. Focused on responsive layouts and intuitive data presentation for complex engineering datasets.

projects.title: Prompt Library
projects.description: Enterprise-ready AI prompt library with role-based access, dynamic filtering, and automated CI/CD deployment. Built in React + TypeScript with server-side Node.js and PostgreSQL integration.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio (Angular)
projects.description: A polished, high-impact portfolio experience designed for recruiters and technical stakeholders, showcasing Angular component architecture, responsive UI, and performance optimizations.

projects.title: Adventure India
projects.description: A premium travel showcase with curated layouts, accessible interactions, and pixel-perfect responsive design. Deployed via GitHub Pages as a modern web experience.
